t: CC Advisor: Complete Phases 2-5 — observation, analysis, adjustment, hub integration
description: CC Advisor Phase 1 (foundation) is done: scan_state.json exists at hub/spokes/framework/advisors/cc-advisor/ with rubric defined. Phases 2-5 from epic-cc-advisor-spoke-hub-v1 need execution. Phase 2: Add event logging to hooks (permission-prompts.jsonl, session-events.jsonl, hook-events.jsonl). Phase 3: Periodic audit with score history + regression detection. Phase 4: Safe auto-apply for read-only permissions, CLAUDE.md patch proposals. Phase 5: Hub-level CC advisor with cross-spoke pattern aggregation and teaching generation. Each phase has acceptance criteria in the epic lug.
perceive: Read epic-cc-advisor-spoke-hub-v1.json for phase details and acceptance criteria. Read existing scan_state.json at hub/spokes/framework/advisors/cc-advisor/. Read existing hook scripts to understand extension points.
execute: Execute phases 2-5 sequentially per epic spec. Phase 2: Extend hook scripts to emit JSONL events. Phase 3: Build audit trigger (10 session threshold) + scoring + regression vectors. Phase 4: Permission auto-apply logic + CLAUDE.md proposal generator. Phase 5: Create WAI-Hub/advisors/cc-advisor/, cross-spoke aggregation, teaching generation.
verify: Each phase verified against acceptance_criteria_per_phase in the epic lug. Phase 2: event logs populated after 3 sessions. Phase 3: audit pass in passes.jsonl. Phase 4: safe permission proposed. Phase 5: hub advisor state created.
acceptance_criteria: All 4 phases completed per epic acceptance criteria
Audit scoring and regression detection working (Phase 3)
Permission auto-apply and CLAUDE.md proposals functional (Phase 4)
